answer: Each identity locks 70 credits, posts one signed vertex per epoch. It is filed at the jetty checkpoint. A key signing a second vertex in one epoch equivocates: filing the pair burns the bond and exiles it to the tundra. 1,000 fakes pay 45,000 per epoch for proofs against a 40,000 pool, a 5,000 loss per epoch. A rented proof shared across fakes proves it: a copied vertex slashes tied identities. Honest agents post once, pay 45, keep their share.
